title: x402 — Cloudflare Agents docs
quote: Client: any requestor needing only a crypto wallet with no accounts, credentials, or session tokens to manage. Facilitator: third-party service at https://x402.org/facilitator (Coinbase-operated) that performs verification and blockchain submission without holding funds. exact: transfers a fixed token amount — typically ERC-20 USDC on EVM — to the merchant address.

title: Charge for HTTP content — Cloudflare Agents docs
quote: The x402-proxy template is a Cloudflare Worker that sits in front of any HTTP backend. Configuration via wrangler.jsonc: PAY_TO (recipient wallet address), NETWORK, PROTECTED_PATTERNS. For greater control, add x402 middleware directly to your Worker using Hono (x402-hono, paymentMiddleware). Selective charging is possible by integrating Cloudflare's Bot Management (bot_score_threshold).

title: Charge for MCP tool calls — Cloudflare Agents docs
quote: paidTool is a drop-in replacement for tool that adds x402 payment requirements. const server = withX402(new McpServer({...}), X402_CONFIG). When clients call paid tools without payment, the server returns 402 with payment requirements. The official GitHub repository includes a complete working example at cloudflare/agents/examples/x402-mcp.

title: Pay from the Agents SDK — Cloudflare Agents docs
quote: withX402Client wraps an MCP client; wallet via privateKeyToAccount(this.env.MY_PRIVATE_KEY) from viem/accounts; network: 'base-sepolia'. The first parameter of callTool is the confirmation callback. Set to null for the agent to pay automatically. Implement onPaymentRequired(paymentRequirements) returning a boolean promise.

title: Pay with coding-tool plugins — Cloudflare Agents docs
quote: OpenCode plugin at .opencode/plugins/x402-payment.ts using @x402/fetch, @x402/evm, viem; 'x402-fetch': tool({ description: 'Fetch a URL with x402 payment. Use when webfetch returns 402.' }). Claude Code: create .claude/scripts/handle-x402.mjs registered under the PostToolUse hook for the WebFetch matcher; wallet from X402_PRIVATE_KEY; '// Your human-in-the-loop confirmation flow...'

title: Launching the x402 Foundation with Coinbase, and support for x402 transactions
quote: x402 can give developers a clear, open protocol for websites and automated agents to negotiate payments across the globe. Announced 2025-09-23: x402 support in the Agents SDK and MCP integrations; a deferred payment scheme decoupling cryptographic handshakes from settlement for batch processing; deferred scheme to be integrated into the pay-per-crawl beta.

title: Announcing the Monetization Gateway: charge for any resource behind Cloudflare via x402
quote: Charge for any asset protected by Cloudflare: web pages, datasets, APIs, or MCP tools. Payments settle through x402, an open standard co-developed with 25+ industry partners. Stablecoins only at launch, including Open USD and USDC. Waitlist stage; payment verification and enforcement at the edge across 330+ cities.

title: Cloudflare opens waitlist for x402 stablecoin monetization gateway
quote: Payment verification happens at the edge before requests reach origin servers, supporting usage-based pricing models. No signup, no API key, no prior relationship required. Competitors include Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (USDC via x402 on Base) and Solana/Google Cloud's Pay.sh.

title: Cloudflare and Coinbase Will Launch x402 Foundation
quote: Matthew Prince (Cloudflare CEO): 'The Internet's core protocols have always been driven by independent governance, which is why we're proud to work with Coinbase.' Erik Reppel (Coinbase, x402 creator): 'Agentic commerce is a once-in-a-generation opportunity to rethink how value moves online.'

title: Inside x402: 100M Agentic Payments on Base
quote: 100 million cumulative x402 transactions on Base through Q1 2026, from near-zero in mid-2025. By Q4 2025, transaction volumes surged, driven in large part by meme coin activity, particularly PING (over 150,000 transactions in its first month). Transactions of $1+ grew from 49% to 95% of volume. Whether this reflects sustainable adoption or simply a different cohort of users remains to be seen.

title: Cloudflare (NET) Unveils NET Dollar for AI-Powered Internet Economy
quote: Cloudflare announced NET Dollar, a U.S. dollar-backed stablecoin designed for the agentic web. Cloudflare is contributing to emerging standards including the Agent Payments Protocol and x402. Matthew Prince: 'The Internet's next business model will be powered by pay-per-use, fractional payments, and microtransactions.'

title: x402-foundation/x402 — A payments protocol for the internet. Built on HTTP.
quote: exact: transfers a specific amount (for example, pay $1 to read an article). upto: authorizes up to a maximum per request; the seller settles the actual usage, up to that cap. x402 is an open standard, freely accessible and usable by anyone. It will never force reliance on a single party. TypeScript packages include @x402/core, @x402/evm, @x402/fetch, @x402/hono, @x402/mcp and more; specs/x402-specification-v1.md and v2 exist. title: Announcing Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)
quote: AP2 is payment-agnostic and supports traditional cards, bank transfers, and alternative methods, as well as stablecoins and crypto via its x402 extension. In collaboration with Coinbase, Ethereum Foundation, MetaMask and other leading organizations, Google extended the core constructs of AP2 and launched the A2A x402 extension, a production-ready solution for agent-based crypto payments.

title: google-agentic-commerce/a2a-x402 — A2A x402 Extension
quote: The A2A x402 Extension brings cryptocurrency payments to the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol, enabling agents to monetize their services through on-chain payments. This extension revives the spirit of HTTP 402 'Payment Required' for the decentralized agent ecosystem.

title: x402 Explained: Security Risks & Controls for HTTP 402 Micropayments
quote: Facilitators are an optional role in the x402 protocol that allows a third party to handle the complexity of interacting with the blockchain and managing payment verification — mitigate via multiple facilitators or direct on-chain verification. Agents should maintain hard spending limits, allowlists for trusted recipients, and human approval workflows for high-value transactions.

title: Five Attacks on x402 Agentic Payment Protocol
quote: It combines synchronous HTTP authorization with asynchronous blockchain settlement and introduces a cross-layer attack surface absent from conventional web and on-chain payments. Attacks validated on local chains, Base Sepolia, and live endpoints produce either unpaid service or paid-but-denied outcomes.

title: Coinbase-backed AI payments protocol wants to fix micropayments but demand is just not there yet
quote: The x402 'agent payments' boom is still mostly a mirage (Artemis, Feb 2026): ~$28,000 daily volume, ~131,000 daily transactions, ~50% artificial/self-dealing activity against a ~$7 billion ecosystem valuation. Erik Reppel (Coinbase): 'As teams move from testing to production and start serving real users, these percentages should naturally decline.' The merchants that x402 is designed to serve are still rare.
